reel_check.Primary read in full; its time and the f: yes: Take-Two 10-K filed 22 May 2026 (GTA V over 225 million sold in), FY2014 and FY2008 10-Ks (release dates), Rockstar's GTA VI page read 8 Nov 03:40Z (19 Nov); evergreen series episode
reel_check.Not already posted (ledger find, Publer: yes: ledger find 'gta v units 225' 0 hits (08:44Z); Publer 1 to 8 Nov has no GTA V sales post
reel_check.Older than 24 hours and nothing new: dro: n/a: series episode requested by Mohammad (studio-gta-vi-series), not news
reel_check.Angle: hook, why now, what it means here: yes: story file angle (longest wait; 11 days to launch; the sequel to a 225-million game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 Nov; the wait ends 19 Nov)
reel_check.NUMBERS: figure, period, source, compari: yes: over 225 million sold in, to 31 Mar 2026, Take-Two, against the 13 years and the 5 years between GTA IV and GTA V
reel_check.One spoken paragraph, then beats: yes: «أطول انتظار في تاريخ GTA. تتجاوز مبيعات GTA V للمتاجر 225 مليون نسخة، حسب تيك-تو. صدرت GTA V في سبتمبر 2013، والانتظار بينها وبين GTA VI 13 عامًا، مقابل 5 سنوات بين GTA IV وGTA V. ينتهي الانتظار في 19 نوفمبر.»
reel_check.Release verbs: yes: صدرت for the past release; no bare تصل
reel_check.Names match names-ar.md: yes: تيك-تو (Take-Two) hyphenated per the glossary (bare تيك تو reads as TikTok), in Mohammad's requested short form; روكستار غيمز (Rockstar Games) in the credit
reel_check.Footage keeps its own sound or series mu: yes: the launch trailer's music stem only (music_only), one stretch from 28.7 s; the job fails if the stem is not clean
reel_check.No narration under Arabic lines: yes: music stem only, voices removed
reel_check.Footage first, official footage: yes: Rockstar's launch trailer; the two cards sit on its moving marina footage
reel_check.Not the same picture as the last 5 Reels: yes: picture: Vice City beach biplane (54.55); none of the last five Reels used the GTA VI launch trailer
reel_check.Credit on every clip: yes: shots 0 to 6, «المصدر: روكستار غيمز (Rockstar Games)»
reel_check.Nothing graphic, nothing leaked: yes: no weapons fired, no injury; launch trailer only, nothing datamined
reel_check.Countdown from the verified date: yes: intro days 11 computed from 8 Nov to 19 Nov (gta_intro.check refuses any other count)

decision_log.why: series identity; «باقي 11 يومًا» counted from 19 Nov

decision_log.shot: L 54.55 beach biplane over Vice City, then L 20.65 the iguana on the Leonida road
decision_log.alternatives: L 66.45 the two embracing on a balcony (v1; reads as a kiss), L 39.95 the two at the car (v2; their faces sat under the headline), L 25.7 convertible (used by the intro), L 52.3 rooftop with rifle (rejected: weapon)
decision_log.crop: 9:16 on the plane (0.45), then on the iguana (0.6)
decision_log.why: recognisable Vice City and Leonida images under «أطول انتظار في تاريخ GTA», with no face under the headline

decision_log.shot: fact card on the marina (L 2.2, dimmed, moving)
decision_log.why: the figure lives on the card only; footage keeps moving behind it

decision_log.shot: L 46.35 to 50.65 continuous: Vice City street cars, the police car, then the bike over the rail line
decision_log.alternatives: L 59.3 masked robbers (rejected: guns), L 57.9 man on a couch
decision_log.crop: tracks the cars, then the bike
decision_log.why: the city in motion under «صدرت GTA V في سبتمبر 2013»; one continuous stretch gives the line its reading time
the comparison that gives the figure meaning

decision_log.shot: L 67.9 helicopter between towers, then L 74.0 to 75.9 Lucia and Jason under water, hand in hand
decision_log.alternatives: L 61.6 group with a man on the ground (rejected: violence implied), L 72.2 (rejected: rifle and fire); L 73.2 start (v1, v2) opened on a close-up of Lucia's dress from behind before the jump, cut
decision_log.why: the last seconds are a picture of the two leads; «ينتهي الانتظار في 19 نوفمبر»
